Chapter 04 · From Soil to Bottle

The Journey of Wild Amla.

Trace the life cycle of our wild-harvested Indian Gooseberry (Phyllanthus emblica)—from shade harvesting to low-temperature extraction.

01

Wild Shade Harvesting

Gathered by certified tribal cooperatives from deciduous forest canopies when tannins reach peak maturity.

02

Stone Crushing & Low-Heat Decoction

Fresh fruit is cold-pressed immediately or slowly simmered into pure sesame oil to preserve natural polyphenols.

03

Batch Chromatography Verification

Every lot is analyzed for botanical identity, moisture content, and absence of heavy metal residues before bottling.
